interpretation: The prototype repairs the observed warm-row failure while preserving the exact finite sampled convex hulls. qualification_limits: Release regression, strict changed-mesh and regression-target Clippy, format checks and independent finite-corpus geometry proofs passed. fuzz_coverage_gap: The inspected existing mesh_and_hull target uses small integer coordinates, so it exercises the retained dyadic heuristic and does not cover the new non-dyadic source-order branch or explicit cache-warming replay. No fuzz campaign was executed here.
